title: Automaton 2000 Micro - Marine Split Battle vs IMMvp
summary: A short demo of Automaton 2000 Micro, a StarCraft bot built in Blizzard's World Editor that splits marines perfectly against banelings. It shows inhuman unit micromanagement with zero losses.
why: Cited in StarCraft AI threads to show how much perfect micro matters, though one commenter finds such play boring.

quote.text: anyone who says that advantage in micromanagement is not a big thing should see "Automaton 2000" videos
